note: Starter scenario→button table. Grounded on the cybercrime.gov.in mapping in portal_map.json; the complaint-flow branch will be enriched once the SPA flow discovery is done (pending). The AI picks ONLY from these buttons and asks when unsure.

scenarios.title: UPI/bank transfer fraud, money sent within 48h
buttons: Online Financial Fraud | UPI fraud payment
extra_actions: emergency freeze request to bank (Requests tab)
scenarios.official_sub_category: Internet banking Related Fraud (UPI money-loss branch)
portal_fields: Have you lost money? -> Yes (M)
Transaction ID / UTR reference (from facts: txn_ref) (M)
Date/Time of transaction dd/mm/yyyy (from facts: timestamp) (M)
Bank Name from which payment was made (M)
Account No. from which amount was paid (M)
Amount Paid (from facts: amount) (M)
Bank in which amount was paid (if known)
Account No. in which amount was paid / fraudster UPI (from facts: upi_id)
Merchant details on which payment was made (if any)
Gateway details (payment gateway, if any)
scenarios.evidence_prep: Keep wallet/receipt screenshots and bank statement saved; do NOT delete originals (§5.2.3.1 Note1).

scenarios.title: Fake job / task scam paid via UPI
buttons: the sub-category shown for advance-fee job offers
scenarios.official_category: Online and Social Media Related Crime
portal_fields: Screenshot/s of fraud job SMS/WhatsApp with sender details (evidence)
Date & Time received / incident (M)
Emails saved as .pdf/.eml with attachments (evidence)
URL of the job page/profile (from facts: other links seen)
Payment trail: amount + UPI/txn (from facts: amount, txn_ref)
Additional information (M)
scenarios.evidence_prep: Save job-offer SMS/emails as pdf/.eml, note the URL; keep attachments ready (§5.1.6).

scenarios.title: Sextortion / photo leak threat
buttons: Sexual abuse/online harassment section (women/child route available)
scenarios.note: Offer the Women & Children related complaint route explicitly.
scenarios.official_category: Online and Social Media Related Crime
portal_fields: Platform where it happened: WhatsApp/talk, email, social media, URL (M)
Date & Time of threats (M)
Screenshots of the demanding messages (evidence)
Suspect number/handle (from facts: phone/account IDs)
Additional information (M)
scenarios.evidence_prep: Screenshot chats showing the sender number + content; export chat to email as .pdf/.eml if possible; preserve originals (§5.1.1).

scenarios.title: Email/social account hacked
scenarios.official_category: Online and Social Media Related Crime
portal_fields: Which account was hacked + when access was lost (Date & Time) (M)
Email header details if phishing led to the takeover (evidence)
Saved emails in .pdf/.eml, screenshots of the takeover (evidence)
Additional information (M)
scenarios.evidence_prep: Save compromise emails as .pdf/.eml, screenshot the takeover screens; change passwords AFTER evidence capture (Annexure B §9).

scenarios.title: KYC/documents used by someone else
scenarios.official_category: Online and Social Media Related Crime
portal_fields: Fake profile / impersonated handle: URL, platform, screenshots (evidence)
Date & Time first seen (M)
Suspect identity details if known (name, mobile, email, PAN etc.)
Additional information (M)
scenarios.evidence_prep: Screenshot the fake profile, copy the URL; preserve the copies online before reporting (§5.1.4).

scenarios.title: Fake online shopping / delivery
buttons: Online and Social Media Related Fraud | Fake/Defective goods
scenarios.official_sub_category: Fake/Defective goods (live-portal term, crawl 2026-10-20) — v10 manual fallback: Any Other Cyber Crime §5.8
portal_fields: Order/product evidence: site URL, order screenshots (evidence)
Date & Time of payment (from facts: timestamp) (M)
Amount paid (from facts: amount) (M)
Payment trail: UPI/txn (from facts: upi_id, txn_ref)
Additional information (M)
scenarios.evidence_prep: Screenshot the product page, chat with seller and payment success screen; keep the order confirmation email.

scenarios.title: Predatory loan app harassment
scenarios.official_category: Online and Social Media Related Crime
scenarios.official_sub_category: Cyber Bullying/Stalking/Sexting (harassment branch) — manual gap; live term: App hijacking/loan app harassment (crawl 2026-10-20)
portal_fields: Threat/abuse call & SMS screenshots; sender numbers (from facts: phone) (evidence)
Date & Time of first demand (M)
Loan app name, money lost (from facts: amount, txn_ref) if any
Contact list abuse evidence if contacts were threatened
Additional information (M)
scenarios.evidence_prep: Screenshot abusive messages + call log entries; keep the app installed as evidence, do NOT delete it yet (Annexure C).

scenarios.title: Private photos leaked, no money lost
extra_actions: Exposure Warning scan of leaked accounts
scenarios.official_category: Online and Social Media Related Crime
portal_fields: Platform + URL where the content is circulating (M)
Date & Time first seen (M)
Screenshots/URL evidence of the leaked or AI-edited content
Suspect handle/identity if known
Additional information (M)
scenarios.evidence_prep: Copy URLs + screenshots of the circulating content; export chats as .pdf/.eml; preserve originals (§5.1.1 Note1).

ask_when_unsure_examples.question: Was it a person you talked to online, or an app/website?

picker_note: Deterministic on-device scoring uses 'keywords' with word-boundary matching and argmax+margin; Gemini pick overrides when API key present.
